reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles, and a single form of magnesium at $30 a month does not hit a problem I feel right now. The lab report and the guarantee are nice, but they do not make me add another bottle.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule for less? And I will probably not finish 30 days anyway, like everything else in that drawer.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video where someone like me shows it fixing my exact problem (sleep or leg cramps after workouts), plus a price near $20 for the first box.
